text: In the bathing house beside the mill. <break time="0.8s" /> The water around Alyohin. <break time="0.8s" /> Turned brown and then dark blue. <break time="0.8s" /> Almost like ink. <break time="0.8s" /> As the dust of many weeks. <break time="0.8s" /> Washed away. <break time="0.8s" /> Meanwhile Ivan Ivanych dived into the millpond. <break time="0.8s" /> With a splash. <break time="0.8s" /> And swam far out in the rain. <break time="0.8s" /> Laughing, diving, and crying out. <break time="0.8s" /> Again and again, Oh, my goodness. <break time="0.8s" /> Burkin had to shout several times. <break time="0.8s" /> That it was enough. <break time="0.8s" /> Before his friend still happily splashing among the water lilies. <break time="0.8s" /> Finally climbed out. <break time="0.8s" /> Later washed and dressed. <break time="0.8s" /> In silk robes and warm slippers. <break time="0.8s" /> The three men sat. <break time="0.8s" /> In the large drawing room upstairs. <break time="0.8s" /> Where Pelageya served them tea with jam. <break time="0.8s" /> From gilded frames on the walls. <break time="0.8s" /> Portraits of stern generals and gentle ladies. <break time="0.8s" /> Looked down on them. <break time="0.8s" /> And the lamp gave the room. <break time="0.8s" /> A warm, peaceful glow. <break time="0.8s" /> Now that they were comfortable at last. <break time="0.8s" /> Ivan Ivanych began the story. <break time="0.8s" /> Of his younger brother, Nikolai. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose life had been spent. <break time="0.8s" /> In a dull government office. <break time="0.8s" /> The two brothers had grown up. <break time="0.8s" /> In the country. <break time="0.8s" /> Running freely through fields and woods. <break time="0.8s" /> And that childhood had left them both. <break time="0.8s" /> With a deep love of country life. <break time="0.8s" /> Sitting at his desk year after year. <break time="0.8s" /> Nikolai dreamed of only one thing. <break time="0.8s" /> A small farm of his own. <break time="0.8s" /> With a garden, ducks on a pond. <break time="0.8s" /> And gooseberry bushes. <break time="0.8s" /> Ivan Ivanych did not admire this dream. <break time="0.8s" /> For he believed. <break time="0.8s" /> That a man needs not six feet of earth. <break time="0.8s" /> But the whole wide world. <break time="0.8s" /> Where he can freely develop his spirit.
